scope: Three new semi-supervised objectives, each with seeds 2026092701/02/03, single source receiver m1-natural, full old three-view PAMF with reference response. Main split excluded. Historical target scores were exposed; this is development evaluation.
initialization: Exact matching source-only original Tri E20 prefix per model seed, then own E10+E20 to fixed E50/11100 updates; fixed graph permutation and original data roles.
evaluation: All nine candidate predictions frozen before independent truth-last score. Clean and six practical scenes, same physical IDs, DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary, cross_date separate from cross_rx/cross_both; report per-seed, scenario, TX/RX/day and same-packet corrections/regressions. No leo_weak, target-guided checkpoint selection or selective rerun. Each of three arms must be reported; no test-based candidate filtering.
success: Aim for greater than 2 percentage points over ordinary PL in clean and every practical DURA-LU scene and improvement over Tri, with individual seed/scene outcomes explicit. A positive result here cannot establish all-settings superiority.
expected_artifacts: Nine genuine source E20 no-query smoke checks
Nine own E30/E50 models and component counters
Nine complete frozen predictions then independent matched three-seed and subgroup scores
